headline: Nestlé Permanently Shuts Down Comestibles La Rosa Factory in Colombia
summary: Nestlé is closing its 75-year-old Comestibles La Rosa plant in Dosquebradas, Colombia. The shutdown ends local production of several brand lines and shifts manufacturing overseas, affecting local suppliers and employment.
why: Nestlé is a global food and beverage conglomerate; asset rationalizations impact regional manufacturing footprints and agriculture supply chains.

impacts.name: Nestlé S.A.
impacts.why: Closing aging production plants reduces regional overhead but incurs operational restructuring costs.
